reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
Pete Hegseth’s DoD has been illegally scraping private medical records in an effort to force out transgender servicemembers.

The government shouldn’t be pawing through anyone’s private medical records – period.

I’m leading the charge alongside @RepDelBene and my fellow @EqualityCaucus co-chairs to stop this blatant overreach and hold Secretary Hegseth accountable.

November is Military Family Appreciation Month! Behind every servicemember is a family that sacrifices for our freedoms. This month and every month, we’re grateful for the spouses, kids, parents and siblings who support our nation’s military.

November is American Diabetes Month, a time to raise awareness and advocate for Minnesotans living with this disease. When I got to Congress, I heard heartbreaking stories from folks across the country who couldn’t afford the insulin they needed to live – they were rationing their medicine or just going without. That’s why, in 2022, I wrote the bill that capped the cost of insulin at $35/month for Medicare recipients, worked to get bipartisan support for our proposal and got it signed into law.

GOOD NEWS: After we forced a vote on the floor, the House just passed the Major Richard Star Act! This bill is a win for the more than 50,000 veterans with combat-related injuries currently being denied full benefits, and for veterans across our country. 

Now it’s time for the
On Veterans Day, we honor our nation’s veterans and thank them for their service to our country. To all those in #MN02 and across our state who answered the call to serve, we are forever grateful.

The Blue Wave has reached DC! I remember when I first came to DC for my New Member orientation after my election in 2018. It was such an exciting time! I’m wishing the best to all the new Members on the Hill this week. https://t.co/40pg1T5pji
Wishing a very Happy Diwali to all those celebrating in Minnesota! May this Festival of Lights bring joy, peace and abundance to you and your loved ones.

Clearly, the president learned nothing from the ass kicking he took from the American people on Tuesday.

Stephen Miller is the architect of the America-last policies voters rejected. 

We will fight every bit of his agenda as Chief of Staff that doesn’t prioritize hard-working

November is Native American Heritage Month!

This month is an opportunity to celebrate the rich cultures, traditions and contributions of Minnesota’s tribal communities. Together, we must honor their resilience and work toward a future rooted in respect and opportunity.

Now let’s get to work. 

https://t.co/aJplB1fOU5

Today is Election Day and I encourage every Minnesotan to make their voice heard.

Polls are open until 8 PM, and remember, you can still register to vote today! For more information on where or how to vote, please check out the link below. Now get out there and vote!

I’m proud to have recently secured nearly $10.2 million in federal funding to upgrade critical infrastructure at the Port of Red Wing. Red Wing Grain purchases soybeans and corn from over 1,200 farmers across the city of Red Wing and ships over 500 river barges of grain per year.

Today is the first day of ACA open enrollment – and as insurance premiums continue to rise as a result of the Administration’s health care cuts, it’s a great time to review your options for 2027. Open enrollment runs through January 15, find more information at: https://t.co/mBKsFHtMd1
Happy Halloween! I’m wishing everyone in Minnesota a safe and spooky day! ￼￼￼🎃👻🕸️

Earlier this year, the Trump Admin deported my constituent, Kenis Lopez Gonzalez — an immigrant from Nicaragua who fled political violence — to the Central African Republic. Kenis is a business owner and had a work permit as well as a court order preventing his deportation.

Third-country deportations are dangerous and unacceptable. There is no reason a law-abiding Minnesotan should be deported to a country where they have never been. This has to stop.
https://t.co/X2JFTT3atF

The Appleton private prison ICE recently purchased from CoreCivic was originally up for sale for $75 million. The Trump Admin bought it for $495.6 million. 

Conveniently, CoreCivic also contributed to Trump’s inauguration. 

This is more than just a sweet deal for CoreCivic —

I joined my MN colleagues urging FEMA to end prolonged delays to federal disaster funding for Minnesotans. Our state needs and deserves prompt federal assistance in the wake of natural disasters – I'm pushing FEMA to remove this burdensome red tape immediately.

Election day is less than a week away and now is the time to make your plan to vote. 

If you haven’t registered to vote yet, it’s not too late. In Minnesota, you can register in-person on election day. Just be sure to bring a proof of residence. More info here:

Minnesotans are tired of President Trump’s politically motivated threats against our state and our state’s leaders.  

Political violence is at an all time high and this is extremely dangerous rhetoric. Every Republican should condemn these lies, especially here in Minnesota. https://t.co/DHCCVa3gVr

President Trump said it himself: 

He doesn’t care that Minnesotans are struggling to afford the basics — he’s making a fortune. 

You deserve better. https://t.co/G8jVePAgVk

The biggest trick this Halloween? President Trump’s economy.

Candy prices are up 19% this year and Minnesota families are paying for it.

Halloween shouldn’t cost a fortune – Minnesotans deserve better.

The Trump Administration is once again refusing to cooperate in the state investigation into Renee Good and Alex Pretti’s deaths earlier this year.

Minnesota has been through enough. The Trump Admin needs to hand over the evidence, cooperate with state officials and give the Pretti and Good families the accountability, justice and closure they deserve.
https://t.co/3dhuY5zRmz

Setting our kids up for success starts with early education. That’s exactly what Head Start provides. 

I’ve fought for Head Start my entire career because I believe every child in Minnesota – no matter their income level or zip code – should have the foundation to make their https://t.co/qgGS8pZd3e

I’m proud to have maintained a perfect score on the @HRC Congressional scorecard since I came to Congress in 2019. I’ll always fight the far-right’s anti-LGBTQ+ agenda so every American can be who they are and love who they love. 🏳️‍🌈🌈 https://t.co/aG05vJ9nKM

posts.text: I’m proud to announce the @NatlParkService is designating Savage as a WWII Heritage City! Whether it was offering translation services, building ships or distributing supplies to aid the war effort, folks in Savage played a critical role during WWII. Today, they are finally

I recently met with the Libets family, my constituents who settled in CD2 after escaping the war in Ukraine. My team helped the Libetses with their visa application when they first arrived in Minnesota as refugees.  

I am proud to stand with Ukraine and will always work to https://t.co/CEvXWmN5l8

It was great to see the Minnesota Biofuels Association in my Eagan office on Friday. I’ve been named their “Biofuels Bulldog”!

I've always fought for year-round E15 for our state’s family farmers, and the MN Biofuels Association has been a criticalpartner in that fight. Thanks https://t.co/MbltcJJArw

Minnesota lost 32,000 jobs and $700 million in wages to Operation Metro Surge. Let that sink in.

Trump’s ICE left a mark on our state that we will feel for generations — psychologically, emotionally and economically. It’s time to pass our Make ICE Pay Act and reimburse Minnesota for the damages ICE inflicted on our economy.

My heart is broken for those impacted by yesterday’s shooting at Silver Rail Elementary. As mothers and grandmothers, Cheryl and I are praying for the families and loved ones of the three children and one teacher who were killed yesterday, as well as the two individuals who were injured.

But our thoughts and prayers aren’t enough. This has to stop.

We need to enact common-sense gun reform, and we needed to do it yesterday. How many lost lives is it going to take?

Inflation shot up to 3.7% in September (a four-month high) and you know it’s bad when even FOX News is calling President Trump’s economy a mess. 

This presidency is a complete failure. It’s time to change course and make life affordable again. https://t.co/GVzbJJ1Nc9

Minnesotans can barely afford the basics and this is what we get from the White House? 

Time for them to get off Canva and start actually doing their jobs. https://t.co/dPA7M7unSp

We’ve seen it time and time again from this administration — lawless government overreach in the name of political retribution. This is beyond the pale, even for them. 

It’s time to stop the attacks on our state and our elected representatives.

https://t.co/9g3K7qQBHe

On Indigenous Peoples’ Day, we celebrate the communities who have called Minnesota home for centuries and recognize their resilience as they faced unthinkable injustice. Their contributions and rich culture continue to shape our nation to this day. 

Today and every day, I stand with Minnesota’s Tribal communities.

My wife Cheryl and I couldn’t be prouder to be a part of the LGBTQ+ community as we celebrate National Coming Out Day. I will always work to make sure every Minnesotan has the freedom to be who they are and love who they love. 🏳️‍🌈🌈

posts.text: Proud to have earned an “A” grade on Defend the Vote’s 2026 legislative scorecard! I’ll always support legislation to crack down on corruption, protect Minnesotans’ access to the ballot box and clean up Washington.

More rants. More racist rhetoric. More political retribution. 

Meanwhile, the greatest threat to Minnesota is this administration. https://t.co/L5Jq2N368B

I am grateful to law enforcement for stopping the planned terror attack at the Mall of America. Their quick work and vigilance saved countless lives. Keeping Minnesotans safe means investing in coordinated counterterrorism and violent crime prevention efforts, and I will continue working to give law enforcement the resources they need to do just that.

Today marks three years since Hamas targeted Israeli civilians in the horrific October 7th attacks.

As we remember the more than 1,200 lives lost and the countless lives changed forever that day, we must commit to fighting antisemitism and hatred in all its forms and continue working toward lasting peace in the Middle East.

posts.text: I’m proud to announce that my office secured more than $2.2 million in federal grants to hire firefighters for the Rosemount Fire Department! I also got word this week that the Lakeville, Shakopee and Woodbury Fire Departments will receive federal grants. Altogether, that’s more than $3.7 million back to fire departments in CD2! This funding will create jobs, protect our firefighters and help keep communities across Minnesota’s Second District safe.

October is LGBTQ+ history month, a chance for us to celebrate the brave folks who have stood up and fought for equal rights, protections and acceptance for our community. We’ve come a long way in this fight, but there’s still more work to do. Together, we’ll keep working toward a future where every Minnesotan can be who they are and love who they love. 🌈🩷

posts.text: Good luck to everyone running the Twin Cities Marathon today! Cheryl and I hope you have a safe, healthy and fun day as you enjoy the most beautiful urban marathon in America. I’ll be cheering you all on. 🏃‍♀️

Cheryl and I are keeping the students, teachers and families impacted by last night’s shooting in Eden Prairie in our prayers today. 

No homecoming celebration should end with gun violence. We’ve got to do better for our kids and pass common sense gun control in this country.

Another disappointing jobs report. Unemployment ticked up to 4.2%, job growth slowed (again) and Minnesotans are feeling it.

President Trump promised a Golden Age — yet opportunities are dwindling, prices are rising and folks can’t keep up.

Minnesotans deserve better.

It’s that time of year! Every fall, I visit Mr. Snobeck’s political science class at Eagan High School to answer questions about our government and share my experience as an elected official.

I had a great time today hearing from and speaking to some of Eagan’s best and brightest.

It was an honor to receive the Mayor’s Award from Newport Mayor Laurie Elliott and the Newport City Council today. Serving Minnesota’s Second District is a true honor, and I couldn’t be more grateful for Mayor Elliott’s partnership over the years. Thank you, Mayor Elliott! https://t.co/C9FKuKa8I0

Hispanic Heritage Month is an opportunity to celebrate the achievements and contributions of Hispanic Minnesotans. This month and always, we celebrate the diversity and rich cultures that make our state stronger!
Cheryl and I got to visit the top of the Capitol Dome in Washington! It was a hike – literally 300 stairs – but I’d say the view was worth it. https://t.co/53Hkcc5CIZ

I’m thrilled, but not surprised, that the Lynx’s own Cheryl Reeve was named WNBA Coach of the Year (again!) and Olivia Miles was unanimously voted WNBA Rookie of the Year! 

Not only have these two had a historic, record-breaking season – they also led the Lynx to the top seed in the playoffs. Cheryl and Olivia, Minnesota couldn’t be prouder of you. 

P.S. Can’t wait to watch you take down the Liberty tonight!

I think we could all use a little Dakota pick-me-up right about now, or should I say... Da-Cow-Ta! 

What do you think of Dakota’s Halloween costume? My wife Cheryl has always wanted a Highland Cow. Dakota is not very amused. https://t.co/cV512SCWJc

Happy National Public Lands Day! 
From neighborhood playgrounds to national parks, our public lands are essential to our communities. Today, let’s commit to protecting these sacred outdoor spaces for generations of Minnesotans to come.🌲⛰️🛶🏕️

President Trump’s vanity projects are slated to cost over $1.8 billion of your tax dollars. That same amount of money could pay for: 

- 600+ million school lunches 
- 12 million Americans’ electric bills for one month 
- A full year of medical bills for 88,000 veterans 
- 27,000+ new firefighters or schoolteachers
- 35+ million tanks of gas for a typical sedan

Minnesotans want a life they can afford – not an algae-green Reflecting Pool and a ballroom built for billionaires.
